minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Financing Authority,
  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency,
  Housing Authority, and Library Board of Trustees*

  December 1, 2014

A Regular Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority, the
Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the
Library Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor
Kelley at 5:05 p.m., on December 1, 2014, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on November 26, 2014, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the Norman
P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Reardon
  Council Member Schlicht (arrived at 5:08 p.m.)
  Council Member Ury (arrived at 5:10 p.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem Leckness
  Mayor Kelley

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

RECESS

At the hour of 5:04 p.m., Mayor Kelley declared a recess. The City Council reconvened at 6:00
p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Pro Tem Leckness

INVOCATION: Council Member Ury

City Council Minutes  1  December 1, 2014
 PRESENTATIONS

P1.  Mayor’s State of the City Address

  Mayor Kelley presented the State of the City video.

P2.  Presentation to and Comments from Outgoing Mayor/Council Member Trish Kelley

  Mayor Pro Tem Leckness presented Trish Kelley with the Mayor's gavel plaque, a city tile
  for her twelve years of service and a certificate of recognition from county Supervisor Pat
  Bates' office. Members of the audience thanked Trish Kelley for her service and
  Mayor Kelley made her outgoing comments.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Dan Avery, M.V.: speaking on behalf of the Friends of the Mission Viejo Library, he announced
that the Friends have raised over $2 million since inception by selling books. He congratulated
the three new Council Members and invited them to a Friends of the Library meeting at their
earliest convenience. Mr. Avery also thanked Mayor Kelley, Council Member Reardon and
Mayor Pro Tem Leckness for their service and support over the years.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Council Member Reardon, to approve the
Consent Calendar as described below.

On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

1.  Waive Reading of Ordinances and Resolutions

  Approved the reading by title of all ordinances and resolutions and declared that said titles
  which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further
  reading waived.

2.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the Regular Meeting of November 17, 2014, as presented.

City Council Minutes  2  December 1, 2014
 3.  Official Results of the November 4, 2014, General Municipal Election

  Adopt Resolution 14-54 Reciting the Fact of the General Municipal Election Held on
  November 4, 2014, Declaring the Result and Such Other Matters as Provided by Law.

4.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended

  The City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars as presented
  in the report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the public record.

COUNCIL RELATED CEREMONIAL ITEMS

5.  Presentation to and Comments from Outgoing Council Members Dave Leckness and
  Rhonda Reardon

  Mayor Kelley presented Dave Leckness and Rhonda Reardon with a city tile and a
  certificate of recognition from County Supervisor Pat Bates' office. Members of the
  audience thanked them for their service and Mayor Pro Tem Leckness and Council
  Member Reardon made outgoing comments.

RECESS

At the hour of 7:49 p.m., Mayor Kelley declared a recess. The City Council reconvened at 8:18 p.m.

CITY COUNCIL ORGANIZATION

6.  Administration of Oaths of Office

  The City Clerk and family members administered Oaths of Office to Council Members-
  Elect Greg Raths, Ed Sachs, and Wendy Bucknum. The City Clerk presented the new
  Council Members with Certificates of Election.

7.  Election of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem for 2015

  Motion made by Council Member Sachs, seconded by Council Member Raths, to appoint
  Cathy Schlicht as Mayor for the current City Council Meeting and for the year 2015.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Raths, Sachs, and Schlicht
  NOES:  Bucknum and Ury
  ABSENT:  None
City Council Minutes  3  December 1, 2014
   Motion made by Mayor Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Bucknum, to appoint Greg
  Raths as Mayor Pro Tem for the current City Council Meeting and for the year 2015.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Raths, Sachs, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Elizabeth Busick, M.V.: on behalf of the Heritage Committee, she gave the new City Council
Members a copy of the City's history book, "Mission Viejo: The Ageless Land."

CONSENT CALENDAR (CONTINUED)

Items 10, 16, and 17 were removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion.

Motion made by Council Member Bucknum, seconded by Council Member Ury, to approve the
Consent Calendar as described below.

On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

AYES:  Bucknum, Raths, Sachs, Schlicht, and Ury
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

8.  Waive Reading of Ordinances and Resolutions

  Approved the reading by title of all ordinances and resolutions and declared that said titles
  which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further
  reading waived.

9.  Quarterly Check Registers and Quarterly Cash Receipts Report - First Quarter of
  FY 2014-15

  Received and filed.

11.  Check Register Dated November 14, 2014 in the Amount of $3,534,339.28

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

City Council Minutes  4  December 1, 2014
 12.  Quarterly Financial Report for the City of Mission Viejo - First Quarter of 2014-15

  Received and filed.

13.  Annual Measure M-2 Expenditure Report for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2014

  Approved Resolution 14-55 Adopting the Measure M2 Expenditure Report for the City of
  Mission Viejo.

14.  La Paz Road Regional Signal Synchronization Project (Project P) Cooperative
  Agreement

  (1) Approved Cooperative Agreement No. C-4-1883 with the Orange County
  Transportation Authority for the La Paz Road Regional Traffic Signal Synchronization
  Project (Project P); and (2) adopted Resolution 14-56 Amending the Fiscal Year 2014-
  2015 Budget to Create Capital Improvement Project 223 for the La Paz Road Regional
  Signal Synchronization Project.

15.  Marguerite Parkway Median Island Improvement, Trabuco Road to Alicia Parkway
  (CIP 221)-Rejection of Bids

  (1) Rejected all bids for the subject project; and (2) authorized staff to re-advertise for
  construction bids for the subject project.

ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

10.  Check Register Dated November 7, 2014 in the Amount of $393,310.30

  Mayor Schlicht inquired about payments made to GameTime for signage at Pavion Park,
  Jamey Clark for park repairs, LSA Associates for professional services for Marguerite
  Tennis Center, RJM Design Group for Marguerite Aquatics Center and Casta del Sol pool
  and spa remodel, and West Coast Turf for La Paws Park.

  Council Member Bucknum asked if the City is reimbursed for plan check fees by the
  applicants and for plant material by the Eagle Scouts.

  Staff provided responses where available and agreed to get back to the City Council with
  details as necessary.

  Motion made by Mayor Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Ury, to receive and file.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

City Council Minutes  5  December 1, 2014
   AYES:  Bucknum, Raths, Sachs, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

16.  Los Alisos Boulevard Pavement Rehabilitation, Interstate 5 to Santa Margarita
  Parkway (CIP 837)

  Mayor Schlicht asked about the differences between the City of Lake Forest's and Mission
  Viejo's requirement for the depth of asphalt cuts.

  Director of Public Works Mark Chagnon stated that the deeper cuts were requested by the
  City of Lake Forest for consistency with their policies and/or to match prior depths.

  Motion made by Mayor Schlicht, seconded by Council Member Bucknum, to (1) authorize
  the City Manager to execute Contract Change Order No. 1 with All American Asphalt in
  the amount of $120,950.79; (2) certify the completion of and accept the improvements for
  the subject project; (3) authorize the City Manager to sign the Notice of Completion; (4)
  authorize the City Clerk to record the Notice of Completion with the County of Orange and
  to release the faithful performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days, respectively,
  after the date of recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no claims or liens
  being filed with the City; and (5) authorize payment of the final retention 35 days after the
  date of recordation of the Notice of Completion.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Raths, Sachs, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

17.  Christopher & Dana Reeve Foundation Grant to Purchase Sports Wheelchairs

  Director of Recreation and Community Services Mark Nix provided a staff report and
  answered Mayor Schlicht's questions.

  Motion made by Council Member Bucknum, seconded by Mayor Schlicht, to adopt
  Resolution 14-57 Amending the Fiscal Year 2014-15 Operating Budget.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Raths, Sachs, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

City Council Minutes  6  December 1, 2014
 MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

18.  Orange County Transportation Authority (OCTA)

  Council Member Ury presented the report.

19.  Appointments to the Foothill/Eastern and San Joaquin Hills Transportation Corridor
  Agencies

  Mayor Schlicht appointed Ed Sachs as representative to the Foothill/Eastern Transportation
  Corridor Agency and Greg Raths as alternate.

  Mayor Schlicht appointed Greg Raths as representative to the San Joaquin Hills
  Transportation Corridor Agency and Ed Sachs as alternate.

STAFF REPORTS

20.  Pre-Budget Discussion Meeting Date

  Director of Administrative Services Cheryl Dyas announced that staff would like to set the
  date of January 16, 2015, to conduct pre-budget discussions among the City Council and
  City Staff.

  Mayor Schlicht stated that she feels it is impractical to have a day-long budget workshop
  on so many topics. She prefers to have staff provide a preview as early as next week and
  break the discussions into 2 or 3 meetings.

  Motion made by Council Member Ury, seconded by Council Member Sachs, to set the date
  of January 16, 2015, to conduct pre-budget discussions among the City Council and City
  Staff.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Bucknum, Raths, Sachs, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

City Council Minutes  7  December 1, 2014
 COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

Council Member Bucknum

Council Member Bucknum stated that she is looking forward to serving on the City Council and
working with her colleagues. She wished everyone a very Merry Christmas and a happy New
Year.

Council Member Sachs

Council Member Sachs announced that while walking precincts prior to the election, he learned
that residents are concerned with traffic synchronization. He noted that the city is spending money
on the Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS) and he stated that the newer system ATM
(Advanced Traffic Management) is more of an active system while ATMS is a reactive
system. Mr. Sachs asked staff to take a look at ATM. Council Member Sachs stated that he
appreciates being elected to the Council and he looks forward to working with his colleagues for
the next four years.

Council Member Ury

Council Member Ury thanked Trish Kelley, Rhonda Reardon and Dave Leckness for their service
on the City Council and he congratulated the three new Council Members. Council Member Ury
congratulated Cathy Schlicht on her position as Mayor and he wished everyone happy holidays.

Mayor Pro Tem Raths

Mayor Pro Tem Raths announced that this was a very special night for him and his
family. He promised to work hard for the city and he stated that he will be available 24/7 and will
do whatever it takes to make the city even better. Mayor Pro Tem Raths thanked residents for
voting for him and he congratulated his newly-elected colleagues and Cathy Schlicht on her
position as Mayor.

Mayor Schlicht

Mayor Schlicht stated that she will get over her fumbles and she will serve the city well as
Mayor. She thanked the newly-elected Council Members for working hard and winning. She
stated that all of the Council Members want to do the best that they can for the City and she thanked
the voters for changing the face of the Council on November 4. Mayor Schlicht stated that she is
looking forward to working with Mayor Pro Tem Raths with his leadership skills, and Ed Sachs
with his business skills. She noted that Mr. Sachs was the youngest president in his company and
he made it very profitable. Mayor Schlicht stated the Council will be working hard and will find
a way to take care of the unfunded liabilities which she thinks are going up.

Director of Administrative Services Dyas responded that the City received the evaluation recently
and the unfunded liability has gone down $2 million.

City Council Minutes  8  December 1, 2014
 Mayor Schlicht concluded by expressing her gratitude and reading a quote: "May the blessing of
the season of expectation be realized in your homes and our community and particularly in the
lives of those who cannot come home."

CLOSED SESSION

21.  Initiation of Litigation Pursuant to Paragraph (4) of Subdivision (d) of Section
  54956.9: One Potential Case.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 9:05 p.m., Mayor Schlicht recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City
Council reconvened at 9:30 p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Curley announced that there was no reportable action from Closed Session.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 9:30 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Schlicht adjourned the meeting to Monday, January 5, 2015, at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of January 5, 2015

City Council Minutes  9  December 1, 2014
